function sanitizeHTML(html){const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(String(html||''),'text/html');const allowed=new Set(['P','BR','STRONG','B','EM','I','U','S','H1','H2','H3','UL','OL','LI','BLOCKQUOTE','A','IMG','INPUT','SPAN','DIV']);for(const el of [...doc.body.querySelectorAll('*')]){if(['SCRIPT','STYLE','IFRAME','OBJECT','EMBED','SVG','MATH'].includes(el.tagName)){el.remove();continue}if(!allowed.has(el.tagName)){el.replaceWith(...el.childNodes);continue}for(const a of [...el.attributes]){const ok=(el.tagName==='A'&&a.name==='href'&&/^https?:\/\//i.test(a.value))||(el.tagName==='IMG'&&a.name==='src'&&/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|webp);base64,/i.test(a.value))||(el.tagName==='IMG'&&a.name==='alt')||(el.tagName==='INPUT'&&['type','checked'].includes(a.name));if(!ok)el.removeAttribute(a.name)}if(el.tagName==='A'){el.setAttribute('target','_blank');el.setAttribute('rel','noopener noreferrer')}if(el.tagName==='IMG'&&!el.hasAttribute('src'))el.remove();if(el.tagName==='INPUT'){if(el.getAttribute('type')!=='checkbox')el.remove();else el.setAttribute('contenteditable','false')}}return doc.body.innerHTML}

const WORLD_THEMES=[
 ['library','Quiet Library'],['observatory','Starlight Observatory'],['seaside-town','Seaside Town'],['creative-studio','Creative Atelier'],['garden','Little Garden'],['research-laboratory','Research Laboratory'],['floating-village','Floating Village'],['mountain-retreat','Mountain Retreat'],['botanical-glasshouse','Botanical Glasshouse'],['night-market','Night Market'],['music-loft','Music Loft'],['ceramics-workshop','Ceramics Workshop'],['canal-town','Canal Town'],['desert-archive','Desert Archive'],['snow-cabin','Snow Cabin'],['underwater-research','Underwater Research'],['rooftop-cafe','Rooftop Café'],['forest-sanctuary','Forest Sanctuary'],['lighthouse-harbor','Lighthouse Harbor'],['cloud-post-office','Cloud Post Office']
].map(([id,title])=>({id,title,image:globalThis.window?.REY_WORLD_ASSETS?.[id]||`assets/worlds/${id}.webp`}));
function hashSeed(value){let h=2166136261;for(const c of String(value)){h^=c.charCodeAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return h>>>0}
function seededRandom(seed){let a=hashSeed(seed);return()=>{a+=0x6D2B79F5;let t=a;t=Math.imul(t^t>>>15,t|1);t^=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,t|61);return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}
const palettes=['blue','ivory','periwinkle'],lights=['morning','dusk','moonlight'],props=['books','plants','stars'];
function buildAppearance(seed,{themes=WORLD_THEMES,favorites=[]}={}){const rand=seededRandom(seed),compatible=themes.filter(t=>favorites.includes(t.id)),pool=compatible.length?compatible:themes;return{appearanceSeed:String(seed),appearanceVersion:1,themeId:pool[Math.floor(rand()*pool.length)].id,palette:palettes[Math.floor(rand()*palettes.length)],lighting:lights[Math.floor(rand()*lights.length)],propStyle:props[Math.floor(rand()*props.length)]}}
function createWorldAppearance({themes=WORLD_THEMES,save=()=>{},favoriteThemes=()=>[],assetMap=()=>globalThis.window?.REY_WORLD_ASSETS||{}}={}){return{themes,appearance(board){if(!board.appearanceSeed){Object.assign(board,buildAppearance(board.id,{themes,favorites:favoriteThemes()}));save()}const theme=themes.find(t=>t.id===board.themeId)||themes[0];return{...board,theme:theme.id,title:theme.title,image:assetMap()[theme.id]||theme.image}},reroll(board){const next=(Number(board.appearanceRoll)||0)+1;Object.assign(board,buildAppearance(`${board.id}:${next}`,{themes,favorites:favoriteThemes()}),{appearanceRoll:next});save();return this.appearance(board)},setTheme(board,id){if(!themes.some(t=>t.id===id))throw Error('Unknown world theme');this.appearance(board);board.themeId=id;save();return this.appearance(board)}}}

const classes={worldEnter:'rey-world-enter',worldExit:'rey-world-exit',wheelOpen:'rey-wheel-enter',wheelClose:'rey-wheel-exit',cardCreate:'rey-card-created',cardSelect:'rey-card-selected',cardExpand:'rey-card-expand',snap:'rey-snap-feedback'};
let setting='system';

function setMotionPreference(value='system'){setting=value==='off'?'off':'system';if(typeof document!=='undefined')document.documentElement.dataset.reyMotion=setting;return setting;}
function animateRey(element,event){const cls=classes[event];if(!element||!cls||reducedMotion())return Promise.resolve(false);element.classList.remove(cls);return new Promise(resolve=>{let done=false;const finish=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(timer);element.removeEventListener('animationend',finish);element.classList.remove(cls);resolve(true);};const timer=setTimeout(finish,480);element.addEventListener('animationend',finish,{once:true});const frame=typeof requestAnimationFrame==='function'?requestAnimationFrame:fn=>setTimeout(fn,0);frame(()=>{if(!done&&element.isConnected!==false)element.classList.add(cls);});});}

const REY_MOTION_EVENTS=Object.freeze({...classes});

const rules=[['business','bikin bisnis|build a business|#business|usaha baru','World untuk ide bisnis'],['learning','belajar|#learn|learning','World untuk belajar'],['content','konten|#content|produksi video','World untuk berkarya'],['research','riset|research|#research','World untuk riset']];

 function restore(stack,opposite){finishCheckpoint();const index=stack.findLastIndex(e=>e.boardId===boardId&&e.patch?.length);if(index<0)return;const entry=stack.splice(index,1)[0];const result=applyRecordPatch(D(),entry.patch,stack===history?'old':'next');opposite.push(entry);selected='';selection.clear();inline='';ensure();loadView();persist();refresh();host.toast(result.conflicts?'Undo menjaga perubahan baru. World yang berisi edit baru bisa dipulihkan di Pengaturan.':'Perubahan '+(stack===history?'dibatalkan':'dikembalikan'))}
 function refreshSelectionUI(){const bar=document.querySelector('.desk-selection-bar');if(bar)bar.outerHTML=selectionBar();const undo=document.querySelector('[data-desk="undo"]'),redo=document.querySelector('[data-desk="redo"]');if(undo)undo.disabled=!history.some(e=>e.boardId===boardId&&e.patch?.length);if(redo)redo.disabled=!future.some(e=>e.boardId===boardId&&e.patch?.length)}
 function selectCard(n,add=false){const ids=n.groupId?notes().filter(x=>x.groupId===n.groupId).map(x=>x.id):[n.id];if(!add)selection.clear();const remove=add&&ids.every(id=>selection.has(id));for(const id of ids)remove?selection.delete(id):selection.add(id);selected=selection.has(n.id)?n.id:[...selection].at(-1)||''}
 function appearance(b=board()){if(!b)return{image:'',theme:'paper',title:'Paper blue'};return host.worlds?.appearance?.(b)||{theme:'paper',title:'Paper blue',image:''}}
 function ancestry(){const out=[],seen=new Set();let b=board();while(b&&!seen.has(b.id)){seen.add(b.id);out.unshift(b);b=D().boards.find(x=>x.id===b.parentId&&!x.archived)}return out}
 function selectionBar(){return `<div class="desk-selection-bar" role="status"><span>${selection.size?selection.size+' kartu dipilih':'Pilih ide, lalu buat sesuatu.'}</span>${action('selection-mode',selectMode?'✓ Pilih banyak':'▧ Pilih banyak',`aria-pressed="${selectMode}"`)}${selection.size>1?action('group','⧉ Group'):''}${notes().some(n=>selection.has(n.id)&&n.groupId)?action('ungroup','Pisahkan'):''}${action('magnet',board().snapEnabled?'🧲 Magnet ON':'🧲 Magnet OFF',`aria-pressed="${!!board().snapEnabled}" title="Tarik tepi atau tengah kartu agar sejajar. Tahan Alt untuk bergerak bebas."`, 'desk-btn magnet-toggle')}${action('wheel','✦ Commands','aria-label="Buka Spatial Command Wheel"')}${action('new-world','＋ Nested World')}${tool==='draw'?`<span class="drawing-controls">${notes().filter(n=>n.kind==='drawing').slice(-3).map(n=>action('delete-drawing','× Stroke',`data-id="${h(n.id)}" aria-label="Remove freehand stroke"`)).join('')}</span>`:''}</div>`}
 function wheelMarkup(){if(!wheel)return '';const n=notes().find(n=>n.id===selected),editable=n&&!n.locked&&!['photo','file','world','drawing'].includes(n.kind);const options=[['wheel-note','▤','Note'],['wheel-text','T','Text'],['wheel-photo','▧','Image'],['wheel-link','↝',n?'Connect':'Link'],['wheel-task','✓',n?'Next step':'Task'],['wheel-shape','◇','Shape'],['wheel-world','✦',n?.kind==='world'?'Enter World':'World'],['wheel-file','▥','File / PDF']];return `<div class="command-scrim" data-desk="wheel-close"></div><div id="deskCommandWheel" class="command-wheel" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Spatial Command Wheel" style="left:${wheel.sx}px;top:${wheel.sy}px"><header><span>${n?'WITH THIS '+h(n.kind||'IDEA').toUpperCase():'MAKE SOMETHING HERE'}</span>${action('wheel-close','×','aria-label="Tutup commands"')}</header><div class="wheel-options">${options.map(([id,icon,label])=>action(id,`<b>${icon}</b><span>${label}</span>`,'','wheel-command')).join('')}</div><small>Context-aware · Escape untuk kembali</small></div>`}
 function openWheel(sx,sy){const vp=$('#deskViewport'),r=vp.getBoundingClientRect();wheel={sx:clamp(sx,200,Math.max(200,vp.clientWidth-200)),sy:clamp(sy,215,Math.max(215,vp.clientHeight-215)),world:screenToWorld(sx,sy,view)};refresh();animateRey($('#deskCommandWheel'),'wheelOpen');setBiuState(document.querySelector('.biu'),'curious');setTimeout(()=>$('#deskCommandWheel button')?.focus(),0)}
 function closeWheel(){wheel=null;refresh();setBiuState(document.querySelector('.biu'),'idle');$('#deskViewport')?.focus()}
 function render(){ensure();document.body.classList.add('blue-desk-page');document.body.dataset.deskScene=scene;return `<section class="desk-intro"><div><div class="desk-eyebrow">YOUR PERSONAL WORKSPACE <span>✦</span></div><h1>Your ideas, organized<span>.</span></h1><p>Capture your thinking, connect ideas, and move projects forward.</p></div><div class="desk-weather"><span>${scene==='midnight'?'☾':'☁'}</span><small>FOCUS<br>AND CREATE</small></div></section><nav class="world-breadcrumb" aria-label="World breadcrumb">${ancestry().map((b,i)=>action('enter-world',`${i?'↳ ':'⌂ '}${h(b.title)}`,`data-id="${h(b.id)}"`)).join('<span>/</span>')}</nav><div class="desk-board-strip">${boards().filter(b=>!b.parentId).map(b=>action('switch',`<span>${stickers[b.cover]||'✦'}</span>${h(b.title)}${b.kind==='project'?'<small>PROJECT</small>':''}`,`data-id="${h(b.id)}"`,boardId===b.id?'board-tab chosen':'board-tab')).join('')}${action('new-board','＋ Ruang baru','','board-tab new-board')}</div><section class="desk-surface"><div class="desk-topline"><div><span class="desk-paper-dot"></span><b>${h(board().title)}</b><small>${board().kind==='project'?'A ROOM FOR YOUR NEXT BIG THING':'YOUR SPATIAL WORKSPACE'}</small></div><div class="desk-scene-controls">${board().parentId&&appearance().image?`<span class="world-header-postcard" aria-hidden="true"><img src="${h(appearance().image)}" alt="" draggable="false"></span>`:''}<select id="deskScene" aria-label="Suasana meja"><option value="morning" ${scene==='morning'?'selected':''}>☀ Morning Blue</option><option value="rain" ${scene==='rain'?'selected':''}>☁ Rainy Afternoon</option><option value="midnight" ${scene==='midnight'?'selected':''}>☾ Midnight Desk</option></select>${action('sound',audio?'♫ Hujan aktif':'♫ Suara hujan',`aria-pressed="${!!audio}"`)}${action('biu-toggle',biuHidden?'✦ Tampilkan Biu':'✦ Biu',`aria-pressed="${!biuHidden}"`)}</div></div><div class="desk-mode-bar">${action('mode-canvas','▤ Meja ide','',deskMode==='canvas'?'mode-tab active':'mode-tab')}${action('mode-week','✓ Minggu ini','',deskMode==='week'?'mode-tab active':'mode-tab')}<span>THINK A LITTLE. MAKE A LITTLE.</span></div><div class="desk-canvas-wrap ${deskMode==='week'?'desk-hidden':''}">${selectionBar()}<div id="deskViewport" data-semantic="${semanticLevel()}" data-magnet="${board().snapEnabled?'on':'off'}" class="desk-viewport ${tool==='pan'?'pan-tool':''} ${selectMode?'selection-tool':''}" tabindex="0" aria-label="Papan ide. N menambah catatan, Space untuk geser, double-click untuk menulis."><div class="desk-tools" role="toolbar" aria-label="Alat papan ide"><div class="tool-group">${action('select','↖','title="Pilih kartu" aria-label="Pilih kartu"',tool==='select'?'desk-tool active':'desk-tool')}${action('pan','✥','title="Geser papan · tahan Space" aria-label="Geser papan"',tool==='pan'?'desk-tool active':'desk-tool')}${action('note','▤ <span>Ide baru</span>','title="Tambah ide · N"','desk-tool note-tool')}${action('text','T','title="Tambah teks" aria-label="Tambah teks"','desk-tool')}${action('shape','◇','title="Tambah bentuk" aria-label="Tambah bentuk"','desk-tool')}${action('photo','▧','title="Tambah foto" aria-label="Tambah foto"','desk-tool')}${action('sticker','✿','title="Stiker" aria-label="Tambah stiker"','desk-tool')}${action('draw','〰','title="Draw freehand" aria-label="Draw freehand"',tool==='draw'?'desk-tool active':'desk-tool')}${action('file','▥','title="Add file or PDF" aria-label="Add file or PDF"','desk-tool')}${action('connect','↝','title="Hubungkan dua kartu" aria-label="Hubungkan kartu"',tool==='connect'?'desk-tool active':'desk-tool')}</div><span class="toolbar-divider"></span><div class="tool-group">${action('undo','↶',`title="Undo · Ctrl Z" aria-label="Undo" ${history.length?'':'disabled'}`,'desk-tool')}${action('redo','↷',`title="Redo · Ctrl Shift Z" aria-label="Redo" ${future.length?'':'disabled'}`,'desk-tool')}</div></div><div class="desk-zoom">${action('zoom-out','−','aria-label="Zoom out"','desk-tool')}<span id="deskZoom">${Math.round(view.z*100)}%</span>${action('zoom-in','＋','aria-label="Zoom in"','desk-tool')}${action('tidy','Rapikan','title="Rapikan kartu yang tidak dikunci"','desk-btn')}${action('fit','⌗','title="Lihat seluruh board" aria-label="Lihat seluruh board"','desk-tool')}</div>${appearance().image?`<div class="world-scenery palette-${h(appearance().palette||'blue')} light-${h(appearance().lighting||'morning')}" aria-hidden="true"><img src="${h(appearance().image)}" alt="" draggable="false"><span></span><i class="world-props prop-${h(appearance().propStyle||'stars')}">${appearance().propStyle==='plants'?'✿ ✿':appearance().propStyle==='books'?'▤ ▥':'✦ ✧'}</i></div>`:''}<div class="desk-ambient"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div><div id="deskWorld" class="desk-world" style="transform:translate(${view.x}px,${view.y}px) scale(${view.z})">${worldMarkup()}</div>${notes().length?'':`<div class="desk-empty"><div class="empty-paper"><span>✦</span><i></i><i></i><i></i></div><h2>Start with one idea.</h2><p>Double-click to create a note, or press N.</p>${action('note','＋ Create first note','','desk-primary')}<small>atau tekan N · paste tulisan / foto</small></div>`}${minimapMarkup()}<div id="deskGuides" class="magnetic-guides" aria-hidden="true"></div><div id="deskMagnetStatus" class="magnet-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></div>${wheelMarkup()}<div class="desk-hint">${tool==='connect'?'Klik kartu pertama, lalu kartu kedua untuk membuat garis.':'Dua kali klik: tulis · Space + drag: geser · pinch / Ctrl + scroll: zoom'}</div>${!biuHidden?`<div class="biu-corner"><div class="biu-speech" id="biuSpeech">Aku jagain idenya. Lu tulis aja.</div><button data-desk="biu-chat" class="biu rey-biu-motion" data-biu-state="idle" aria-label="Sapa Biu">${star}</button><small>biu, your desk buddy</small></div>`:''}</div></div>${deskMode==='week'?weekMarkup():''}<div class="desk-bottomline"><span>● Semua ide tersimpan di browser ini</span><div>${board().parentId?action('exit-world','↰ Keluar World'):''}${action('appearance','✦ Tampilan World')}${action('reroll-world','↻ Reroll')}${action('rename','✎ Nama ruang')}${action('delete-board','Arsipkan ruang')}${board().kind==='project'?action('complete-project','✦ Made it happen',`${board().completed?'disabled':''}`):action('projectify','Jadikan project room ↗')}</div></div></section><section class="desk-week-preview"><div><small>FROM A LITTLE IDEA TO A LITTLE ACTION</small><h2>Langkah berikutnya.</h2><p>Kartu yang dijadikan to-do tetap terhubung ke ide asalnya.</p></div><div>${D().tasks.filter(t=>t.boardId===boardId&&!t.archived).slice(0,4).map(t=>`<label class="desk-task-pill ${t.status==='Selesai'?'done':''}"><input type="checkbox" data-task="${h(t.id)}" ${t.status==='Selesai'?'checked':''}><span>${h(t.title)}<small>${t.date?h(t.date):'Belum dijadwalkan'}</small></span></label>`).join('')||'<div class="desk-task-placeholder">Pilih sebuah kartu → Jadikan to-do → Pilih hari.</div>'}</div></section>${host.relatedMarkup?.(boardId)||''}${board().completed?'<div class="desk-made-stamp">MADE IT HAPPEN<br><small>'+h(board().completedAt)+'</small></div>':''}`}

 function weekMarkup(){const d=new Date(today()+'T12:00:00Z');d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()-((d.getUTCDay()+6)%7)+weekOffset*7);const days=Array.from({length:7},(_,i)=>{const q=new Date(d);q.setUTCDate(q.getUTCDate()+i);return q.toISOString().slice(0,10)});const tasks=D().tasks.filter(t=>t.boardId===boardId&&!t.archived);const taskCard=t=>`<article class="week-action-card ${t.status==='Selesai'?'week-done':''}" draggable="true" data-desk-task="${h(t.id)}"><label><input type="checkbox" data-task="${h(t.id)}" ${t.status==='Selesai'?'checked':''}><span>${h(t.title)}</span></label><div>${action('edit-linked-task','Atur tanggal',`data-id="${h(t.id)}"`)}${t.ideaId?action('task-source','↗ Ide asal',`data-id="${h(t.ideaId)}"`):''}</div></article>`;return `<section class="desk-week-board"><div class="weekly-heading"><div><span>ONE WEEK, A FEW GOOD STEPS</span><h2>Ruang buat langkah kecil.</h2><p>Geser kartu ke harinya. Ide asalnya tetap bisa dibuka.</p></div><div>${action('week-prev','‹')}${action('week-today','Minggu ini')}${action('week-next','›')}</div></div><div class="weekly-columns"><section class="week-action-column someday" data-week-drop=""><header><small>SOMEDAY</small><h3>Nanti dulu ☁</h3></header>${tasks.filter(t=>!t.date).map(taskCard).join('')}<span class="week-drop-hint">Taruh yang belum perlu tanggal di sini.</span></section>${days.map(day=>`<section class="week-action-column ${day===today()?'current-day':''}" data-week-drop="${day}"><header><small>${new Date(day+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('id-ID',{weekday:'short'}).toUpperCase()}</small><h3>${+day.slice(8)} <span>${new Date(day+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('id-ID',{month:'short'})}</span></h3></header>${tasks.filter(t=>t.date===day).map(taskCard).join('')}<span class="week-drop-hint">Ruang untuk satu langkah.</span></section>`).join('')}</div>${tasks.some(t=>t.date&&(t.date<days[0]||t.date>days[6]))?`<div class="outside-week"><small>DI LUAR MINGGU INI</small>${tasks.filter(t=>t.date&&(t.date<days[0]||t.date>days[6])).map(t=>`<span>${h(t.date)}</span>${taskCard(t)}`).join('')}</div>`:''}<div class="weekly-footer">✓ Status dan tanggal yang sama muncul di Dashboard & Calendar.</div></section>`}
 function worldMarkup(){const b=board(),items=notes(),frames=b.kind==='project'?['Tujuan','Referensi','Pertanyaan','Keputusan','Langkah berikutnya'].map((title,i)=>`<div class="desk-frame" style="left:${i*310+30}px;top:45px"><span>${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><h3>${title}</h3></div>`).join(''):'';return `${frames}<svg class="desk-connectors" width="6000" height="4000"><defs><marker id="deskArrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto"><path d="M1 1L9 5L1 9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/></marker></defs>${D().links.filter(l=>l.boardId===boardId&&!l.archived).map(l=>{const a=items.find(n=>n.id===l.from),b=items.find(n=>n.id===l.to);return a&&b?`<path d="${pathBetween(a,b,l.fromSide,l.toSide)}" data-link="${h(l.id)}" marker-end="url(#deskArrow)"/>`:''}).join('')}</svg><svg class="desk-drawings" width="6000" height="4000" aria-label="Freehand drawings">${items.filter(n=>n.kind==='drawing').map(n=>drawingMarkup(n)).join('')}</svg>${items.filter(n=>n.kind!=='drawing').map(cardMarkup).join('')}`}
 function drawingMarkup(n){let points=[];try{points=JSON.parse(n.pointsJSON||'[]')}catch{}const valid=Array.isArray(points)?points.filter(p=>Array.isArray(p)&&p.length===2&&p.every(Number.isFinite)).slice(0,3000):[];return valid.length?`<path data-drawing="${h(n.id)}" d="${valid.map((p,i)=>(i?'L':'M')+' '+p[0]+' '+p[1]).join(' ')}"/>`:''}
 function cardMarkup(n){const task=D().tasks.find(t=>t.id===n.taskId&&!t.archived),sticker=stickers[n.sticker]||'',safePhoto=/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|webp);base64,/.test(n.image||'');return `<article class="desk-note ${Date.now()-new Date(n.createdAt||0).getTime()<500?'note-new':''} ${n.kind==='photo'?'photo-note':n.kind==='sticker'?'sticker-note':n.kind==='text'?'text-note':n.kind==='shape'?'shape-note':'paper-note'} color-${h(n.color||'blue')} ${selection.has(n.id)||selected===n.id?'selected':''} ${n.kind==='world'?'world-portal':''} ${n.kind==='file'?'file-note':''} ${task?.status==='Selesai'?'note-completed':''} ${n.locked?'note-locked':''}" style="left:${n.x}px;top:${n.y}px;width:${n.width||230}px;height:${n.height||185}px;--tilt:${n.tilt||0}deg" data-note="${h(n.id)}" tabindex="0" aria-label="${h(n.title||'Ide baru')}"><div class="note-grip" title="Geser kartu">⠿</div>${n.kind==='link'?`<div class="note-eyebrow">REFERENCE LINK</div><h3>${h(n.title||n.url||'Link')}</h3><p>${h(n.body||n.url||'')}</p>${/^https?:\/\//.test(n.url||'')?`<a href="${h(n.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="desk-file-download">Open reference ↗</a>`:''}`:n.kind==='file'?`<div class="note-eyebrow">FILE · LOCAL VAULT</div><div class="file-glyph">▤</div><h3>${h(n.title||'Attachment')}</h3><p>${h(n.body||'Tersimpan di perangkat ini. Backup menyertakan file.')}</p>${action('download-asset','↓ Buka / unduh',`data-asset="${h(n.assetId||'')}" aria-label="Unduh ${h(n.title||'file')}"`,'desk-file-download')}`:n.kind==='world'?`<button class="world-enter" data-desk="enter-world" data-id="${h(n.worldId)}" aria-label="Masuk World ${h(n.title)}">${appearance(D().boards.find(b=>b.id===n.worldId)).image?`<img src="${h(appearance(D().boards.find(b=>b.id===n.worldId)).image)}" alt="" draggable="false">`:'<span class="portal-star">✦</span>'}<span class="portal-caption"><b>${h(n.title)}</b><small>OPEN A LITTLE WORLD ↗</small></span></button>`:n.kind==='photo'?`<div class="paper-tape"></div>${n.assetId?`<img data-asset-image="${h(n.assetId)}" ${assetURLs.has(n.assetId)?`src="${assetURLs.get(n.assetId).url}"`:''} draggable="false" alt="${h(n.title)}">`:safePhoto?`<img src="${n.image}" draggable="false" alt="${h(n.title)}">`:''}<span class="photo-caption">${h(n.title)}</span>`:n.kind==='sticker'?`<span class="big-sticker">${sticker||'✦'}</span>`:`<div class="note-eyebrow">${task?'↗ '+h(task.status==='Selesai'?'DONE':'NEXT STEP'):'A LITTLE THOUGHT'}<span>${sticker}</span></div>${inline===n.id&&!n.locked?`<input class="inline-title" data-inline="title" maxlength="1000" aria-label="Judul ide" placeholder="Ide kecil…" value="${h(n.title)}"><textarea class="inline-body" data-inline="body" aria-label="Isi ide" placeholder="Tulis langsung di sini…">${h(n.body||'')}</textarea>`:`<h3>${h(n.title||'Tanpa judul')}</h3><p>${h(n.body||'Klik dua kali untuk menulis langsung…')}</p>`}${task?`<div class="note-task-label">✓ ${h(task.date||'Belum dijadwalkan')}</div>`:''}`}${selected===n.id&&selection.size<=1?`<div class="note-actions">${action('inline','✎','title="Tulis langsung" aria-label="Tulis langsung"')}${action('open-note','⛶','title="Menulis fokus" aria-label="Menulis fokus"')}${action('lock',n.locked?'♙':'♧',`title="${n.locked?'Buka kunci':'Kunci posisi'}" aria-label="${n.locked?'Buka kunci':'Kunci posisi'}"`)}${n.kind==='sticker'?'':action('promote','↗','title="Jadikan to-do" aria-label="Jadikan to-do"')}${action('duplicate','⧉','aria-label="Duplikat"')}${action('delete-note','×','aria-label="Arsipkan kartu"')}</div>${n.locked?'':`<span class="resize-handle" aria-label="Resize kartu"></span>`}<div class="inline-colors">${['blue','cream','lavender','rose'].map(c=>action('card-color',`<span class="swatch ${c}"></span>`,`data-color="${c}" aria-label="Warna ${c}"`)).join('')}</div>${['left','right','top','bottom'].map(side=>action('branch','＋',`data-side="${side}" title="Cabang ide ${side}" aria-label="Cabang ide ${side}"`,'branch-port port-'+side)).join('')}`:''}</article>`}
 function refresh(){if(host.isDesk()){$('#main').innerHTML=render();bind()}}
 function refreshWorld(){if(!$('#deskWorld'))return;$('#deskWorld').innerHTML=worldMarkup();$('#deskWorld').style.transform=`translate(${view.x}px,${view.y}px) scale(${view.z})`;$('#deskZoom').textContent=Math.round(view.z*100)+'%';bindInline();loadCardAssets();updateSemantic();refreshMap();$('#deskViewport')?.style.setProperty('background-position',`${view.x}px ${view.y}px`)}
 function focusInline(){document.querySelector('[data-inline="title"]')?.focus()}
 function bindInline(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-inline]').forEach(el=>{el.onfocus=()=>setBiuState(document.querySelector('.biu'),'focusing');el.onblur=()=>setBiuState(document.querySelector('.biu'),'idle');el.oninput=()=>{const n=notes().find(n=>n.id===inline);if(!n||n.locked)return;n[el.dataset.inline]=el.value;n.updatedAt=new Date().toISOString();persist()}})}
 function mapBounds(){const vp=$('#deskViewport'),left=-view.x/view.z,top=-view.y/view.z,right=left+(vp?.clientWidth||950)/view.z,bottom=top+(vp?.clientHeight||600)/view.z;return{x:Math.min(left,...notes().map(n=>n.x))-80,y:Math.min(top,...notes().map(n=>n.y))-80,r:Math.max(right,...notes().map(n=>n.x+(n.width||230)))+80,b:Math.max(bottom,...notes().map(n=>n.y+(n.height||185)))+80}}
 function minimapMarkup(){const q=mapBounds(),vp=$('#deskViewport'),w=q.r-q.x,hgt=q.b-q.y;return `<div id="deskMini" class="desk-minimap"><small>PETA IDE · KLIK UNTUK PINDAH</small><svg id="deskMap" viewBox="${q.x} ${q.y} ${w} ${hgt}" preserveAspectRatio="none" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Peta ide: klik untuk navigasi, Enter untuk lihat semua">${notes().map(n=>`<rect data-map-note="${h(n.id)}" x="${n.x}" y="${n.y}" width="${n.width||230}" height="${n.height||185}" rx="9" fill="${({blue:'#a4bedc',cream:'#dcccaa',lavender:'#bcaed6',rose:'#ddb6bd'})[n.color]||'#a4bedc'}"/>`).join('')}<rect class="map-camera" x="${-view.x/view.z}" y="${-view.y/view.z}" width="${(vp?.clientWidth||950)/view.z}" height="${(vp?.clientHeight||600)/view.z}"/></svg></div>`}
 function refreshMap(){const mini=$('#deskMini');if(mini){mini.outerHTML=minimapMarkup();bindMap()}}
 function updateGesture(){frame=0;updateSemantic();const w=$('#deskWorld');if(!w)return;w.style.transform=`translate(${view.x}px,${view.y}px) scale(${view.z})`;$('#deskZoom').textContent=Math.round(view.z*100)+'%';const vp=$('#deskViewport');vp?.style.setProperty('background-position',`${view.x}px ${view.y}px`);if(drag?.items)for(const n of drag.items){const el=document.querySelector(`[data-note="${n.id}"]`);if(el){el.style.left=n.x+'px';el.style.top=n.y+'px';el.style.width=(n.width||230)+'px';el.style.height=(n.height||185)+'px'}}const items=notes(),byId=new Map(items.map(n=>[n.id,n])),linksById=new Map(D().links.map(l=>[l.id,l]));document.querySelectorAll('[data-link]').forEach(el=>{const l=linksById.get(el.dataset.link),a=byId.get(l?.from),b=byId.get(l?.to);if(a&&b)el.setAttribute('d',pathBetween(a,b,l.fromSide,l.toSide))});const q=mapBounds(),map=$('#deskMap');if(map){map.setAttribute('viewBox',`${q.x} ${q.y} ${q.r-q.x} ${q.b-q.y}`);const cam=map.querySelector?.('.map-camera');if(cam)for(const[k,v]of Object.entries({x:-view.x/view.z,y:-view.y/view.z,width:vp.clientWidth/view.z,height:vp.clientHeight/view.z}))cam.setAttribute(k,v);map.querySelectorAll?.('[data-map-note]').forEach(el=>{const n=byId.get(el.dataset.mapNote);if(n)for(const[k,v]of Object.entries({x:n.x,y:n.y,width:n.width||230,height:n.height||185}))el.setAttribute(k,v)})}const layer=$('#deskGuides');if(layer)layer.innerHTML=guides.map(g=>`<span class="snap-guide ${g.axis} ${g.source==='grid'?'grid-guide':'card-guide'}" style="${g.axis==='x'?'left':'top'}:${(g.value*view.z+(g.axis==='x'?view.x:view.y))}px"><i></i></span>`).join('');updateMagnetFeedback(vp)}
 function updateMagnetFeedback(vp=$('#deskViewport')){
  const held=drag?.kind==='note'&&guides.length>0,nextHeld=new Set(held?drag.items.map(n=>n.id):[]),nextTargets=new Set(held?guides.filter(g=>g.source==='card'&&g.targetId!=null).map(g=>g.targetId):[]);
  for(const [before,after,cls] of [[magnetHeldIds,nextHeld,'magnet-held'],[magnetTargetIds,nextTargets,'magnet-target']]){for(const id of before)if(!after.has(id))document.querySelector(`[data-note="${id}"]`)?.classList.remove(cls);for(const id of after)if(!before.has(id))document.querySelector(`[data-note="${id}"]`)?.classList.add(cls)}
  magnetHeldIds=nextHeld;magnetTargetIds=nextTargets;if(vp){vp.dataset.magnet=board()?.snapEnabled?'on':'off';vp.dataset.magnetHeld=held?'true':'false'}
  if(!held){const layer=$('#deskGuides');if(layer)layer.innerHTML=''}
  const status=$('#deskMagnet
